title: The gate's rule actually covers the risky tools
why: In Claude Code a matcher like "mcp__gatetrap" (no wildcard) matches nothing, and "Edit.*" also matches NotebookEdit. A typo makes a gate silently skip tools. This case reads the gate's settings file and checks every risky trap tool against its PreToolUse matchers. It runs only when the gate config names a settings file.
